messages:
Ivy Chen: Hey team — opened PR to expand the Private install guide with an HSM appendix and concrete air-gapped curl + SDK examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3872. Mainly adding vendor notes and a small nftables troubleshooting section.
Luca Moretti: Nice. Quick skim: can we call out vendor differences? e.g., Thales nCipher needs ephemeral UDP ports for admin traffic, whereas some cloud HSMs only use TCP. Otherwise people will get tripped during preprod.
Ivy Chen: Good point. I'll add a short vendor-compat table and a note about UDP ephemeral ranges.
Hari Nair: Also add an example for verifying TLS handshake from the installer host. People in on-prem setups often forget to test the local cert store. I suggest an openssl s_client snippet.
Ivy Chen: Adding that. Proposed openssl check: `openssl s_client -connect hsm.internal:8443 -CAfile /etc/redwood/ca.pem -showcerts` — will paste in the doc.
Ops (infra): For the firewall note, please include nft examples we use in the infra runbook. Most customers use nftables these days (iptables is still common but out-of-box examples should prefer nft).
Ivy Chen: I'll add both snippets. For nft: `nft add rule inet redwood-internal tcp dport 8443 accept` and a short explanation about persisting rules.
Ivy Chen: Also updating the air-gapped curl example to use --cacert and --resolve like this:
```bash
# rotate HSM key from installer VM (air-gapped)
HSM_HOST=10.0.3.12 HSM_PORT=8443
curl --cacert /etc/redwood/ca.pem \
  --resolve "hsm.internal:${HSM_PORT}:${HSM_HOST}" \
  -X POST https://hsm.internal:${HSM_PORT}/api/v2/keys/rotate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $HSM_ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"key_id":"prod-wrapper-01","mode":"scheduled"}'
```
Luca Moretti: Looks good. Can we also show a short Python SDK example that reads REDWOOD_KMS_URL and REDWOOD_CA_PATH from env? That helps customers who embed in internal services.
Ivy Chen: Sure, adding this simple snippet:
```python
import os
from redwood_sdk import PrivateKMSClient

base = os.environ.get("REDWOOD_KMS_URL", "https://kms.internal:443")
ca = os.environ.get("REDWOOD_CA_PATH", "/etc/redwood/ca.pem")
client = PrivateKMSClient(base_url=base, ca_path=ca)
key = client.fetch_wrapping_key("prod-wrapper-01")
print(key.id)
```
Hari Nair: One nit: in the key rotation section avoid language that implies plaintext key export. We should be explicit: HSM performs rotation without exporting key material and SDK calls never receive unwrapped symmetric keys.
Ivy Chen: Good call, reworded the sentence to clarify rotation is HSM-local and SDK receives only wrapped key blobs.
Ops (infra): Minor: the network diagram referenced in the guide is named `private-network-v2.png` in the assets folder; the markdown currently points to `private-network.png`. Small rename will avoid 404s.
Ivy Chen: Thanks — will update the markdown.
docs-bot: CI: docs lint and linkcheck running for PR #3872.
Luca Moretti: When this merges can we backport a short callout to the on-prem migration checklist about running `openssl s_client` and a test rotation in preprod? Saved us twice.
Ivy Chen: Absolutely. I'll add a one-line checklist item: "Verify HSM connectivity and perform a test key rotation in preprod."
docs-bot: CI: linkcheck found 1 broken link in PR #3872 (assets/private-network.png -> assets/private-network-v2.png).
Ivy Chen: Fixed the image path and pushed a commit. Also added vendor notes and the nft/iptables examples.
docs-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #3872  5 files changed, 1 image renamed.
Hari Nair: LGTM from security review (checked wording around wrapped keys and no mention of exporting plaintext).
Luca Moretti: LGTM from docs once the openssl note has the expected exit code mention (non-zero on failure).
Ivy Chen: Added the exit code note and merged after CI green. Backport pushed to the migration checklist branch. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
